about: Banned and replaced words in player-facing text (GitHub #203, FAL-1032). writing/glossary.md is the human copy; keep the two in step. Each pattern is a case-insensitive regular expression unless case_sensitive is true. scope 'ui' means string literals in game/ui/*.gd, game/audio/*.gd, game/scenes/*.tscn and the player-facing names in game/engine/bazaar.gd and game/engine/dungeon.gd; 'all' adds the player-facing text fields in game/data/*.json and assets/journey/**/*.json (name, taunt, label, hit, done, lines). Comments, ids, save keys, routes, node names and dictionary keys are never checked. 'allow' lists exact strings that may match.

banned.use: the place's own name (Scrap Fields, Signal Tower, Dry Flats, Radio Spires, Engine Core, Thunderdome, Bazaar); 'zone' in docs only
